verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own product page directly claims the story: enforcing code quality policies and compliance requirements across the organization with "standardized, customizable merge checks" [docs-7]. It also claims enforcement of coding standards and CI/CD policies across all repos [docs-6] and third-party code reports surfaced on the PR screen [docs-11]. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how custom merge checks are configured and enforced (e.g., required builds, approvals, blocking conditions), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing copy.
